# E-M10 Mark II native settings tab with saved values, fenykl main plugin

A twelfth Custom menu tab, L. Fenykl, drawn and edited by the stock menu code; values persist on the card across boots.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md) · **Project:** [fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Mod build:** main plugin (2026-11-20 builds)

The main plugin adds Custom menu tab L by data writes into the menu's tables, with one native row per setting and borrowed stock pickers; a value set there is saved to the card and read back after a reboot.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M10 Mark II fenykl settings tab: maintainer's camera](../evidence/em10-ii-fenykl-settings-tab.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; release label only.

## Limits

- The values live in files on the card, not in the camera's own settings store; without the plugin the tab is absent.
- On, Off and lists of names only; numeric settings are refused.
- One camera; the larger configurations (40 rows, lists of 26 names) were run with a separate RAM table on the same day.
